name: @elizaos/plugin-inbox-client
description: Browser-safe mailbox listing, grants, drafts, background notices and managed Gmail client.

scripts.sync:gen: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),srcGen=path.resolve('../plugin-inbox/gen'),dstGen=path.resolve('gen');if(!fs.existsSync(srcGen))throw new Error('packages/plugin-inbox/gen is missing; run pnpm gen first');const needed=new Set(['package.json']),seen=new Set(),walk=d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(/\.(?:ts|vibe)$/.test(e.name)){for(const m of fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').matchAll(/from\s+['\"]\.{1,3}\/(?:\.\.\/)*gen\/([^'\"]+)['\"]/g))add(m[1]);}}},add=n=>{if(seen.has(n))return;const f=path.join(srcGen,n);if(!fs.existsSync(f))return;seen.add(n);needed.add(n);for(const m of fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').matchAll(/from\s+['\"]\.\/([^'\"]+)['\"]/g))add(m[1]);};walk('src');walk('test');fs.mkdirSync(dstGen,{recursive:true});for(const n of needed){const s=path.join(srcGen,n),d=path.join(dstGen,n),t=fs.readFileSync(s,'utf8');if(!fs.existsSync(d)||fs.readFileSync(d,'utf8')!==t)fs.writeFileSync(d,t);}for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dstGen))if(!needed.has(f))fs.rmSync(path.join(dstGen,f),{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.build: pnpm run sync:gen && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vibelang -p tsconfig.build.json
